function.name: Code_Executor
function.arguments:
{"code": "
import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get references to scan and controller objects
scan = application.Scan
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set PID gains
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000

# Try to set D gain if available
try:
    zcontrol.DGain = 10
    dgain_set = True
except AttributeError:
    dgain_set = False

# Set scanning parameters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # Time per line in seconds
scan.Lines = 128  # Lines per frame

# Verify settings
print("PID Gains set:")
print(f"  P Gain: {zcontrol.PGain}")
print(f"  I Gain: {zcontrol.IGain}")
if dgain_set:
    print(f"  D Gain: {zcontrol.DGain}")
else:
    print(f"  D Gain: Not available in this controller")

print("\nScanning Parameters set:")
print(f"  Time per Line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Lines per Frame: {scan.Lines}")

del spm
"}
